excerpt.zh: 随着帝国的发展，新的£colony£殖民地可以被划归进星域。星域可以在星球与星域界面进行自动管理，自动对£district£区划与£building£建筑进行建造与升级。
excerpt.en: As our empire grows, new £colony£ Colonies can be organized into Sectors. Sectors can be automated from the Planets and Sectors screen to automatically build and upgrade £district£ Districts and £building£ Buildings using assigned pools of resources.
